ios.desc:
Lifestack is your AI-powered daily planner that helps you stay productive without burnout. Ask AI anything, from building a full day plan to creating routines, and Lifestack will turn your todos into a smart calendar aligned with your energy levels. It also integrates with Apple Health and supported wearable devices to sync sleep, activity, and heart rate data so your plan adapts in real time.

**Made for Focus & Energy**

・Energy-first planning: schedule tasks when your focus peaks

・ADHD-friendly design: structured routines, reminders & clear time blocks

・Health-powered insights: connect to Oura, WHOOP, Garmin, Apple Watch, FitBit, and more

**Key Features**

・Ask AI to plan your day, week, or routines

・Smart time blocking from todos to calendar

・Energy predictions to match tasks with focus levels

・Integrations with Google Calendar, Outlook, Todoist, Trello and more

・AI-powered suggestions for work, health & rest

**Why Lifestack?**

・Boost focus, energy & productivity

・Balance work, health & recovery

・Designed to support ADHD and energy management

Take control of your day with smarter planning. Download Lifestack and experience the future of energy-focused productivity.

Lifestack is "Stack" of your "Life".

—--

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

A subscription is required to access the content.

show_hn.title: Show HN: First calendar app using health data from wearables (submitted to F24)

quotes.text:
My cofounders and I have developed the first calendar app that integrates health data from wearable devices to help you plan their schedules around you peak productivity times. We calculate your energy levels throughout the day using your sleep data, circadian rhythm, subjective feelings, and many other metrics that we'll be adding in the future!

It’s now available on the App Store, Play Store, and even as a Chrome extension.

[App Store]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lifestack-calendar-and-health/id6473464429

[Play Store]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.demind.lifestack_calendar&hl=en_US&gl=US

[Chrome Extension]: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/lifestack-extension/mbpcaihbaecjnndomdpkigmmhdnfccjb

We've also submitted it to F24! We hope you'll give it a try, and we're excited to hear your feedback!
